scope: CUA browser to disposable Anvil chain 31337, receipt, refreshed balances/positions; no public-chain writes

flows.details: Faucet; native AVAX, awAVAX and vaDEMO buy and sell; exact reviewed bounds; buy-to-protect continuity. Excess inventory request blocked before signing.
AVAX wrap and unwrap; protected vaDEMO and collateral bvaDEMO deposit and redeem. Confirmed balances refreshed.
awAVAX protection; partial asset and backing exits; remaining position transfer to a second disposable account; recipient exits remainder and previous owner loses control.
Deposit 500 aDEMO; claim earned awAVAX fees; request notice; partial withdrawal of 100 shares leaves 400; paid asset/backing basket and cleared notice.
Invalid 124% collateral blocked. Created native AVAX / bvaDEMO pool with 160% collateral, 12% provider fee, 2% creator fee, 1-day epoch and 500 bvaDEMO seed. Custom terms displayed correctly.
Native partial gain exit in custom pool; creator claimed 0.000005 AVAX and provider claimed 0.00003 AVAX, separately from redeemable principal.

With chain mature while workstation was still a day earlier, a third party settled the position. Provider then withdrew all shares before holder claimed 0.025 bvaDEMO; holder credit remained intact. Final shares, holder credit and protection reserve zero.
Local wallet rejected a wrap signature; consumed review removed Confirm. Fresh review and successful wrap cleared prior error.
Switching disposable accounts cleared account state and required reconnect. Simulated local network-change event cleared wallet, balances and review; fresh reconnect/review/wrap succeeded.
Paused allowance signature, navigated away, resumed signature. Only allowance was broadcast; hidden protection blocked. Final wrapped nextPositionId=2 and reservedBacking=0.

Paused local automining; browser broadcast unwrap; after actual 120-second timeout Activity retained the hash with unknown status and no reusable confirmation. Restoring mining confirmed that exact hash. Historical Activity status does not automatically reconcile; local RPC lookup provided final confirmation.

automatedRegressions: Late pre-transaction read cannot replace newer post-receipt balances/positions.
Unmounted review cannot continue after delayed approval.
Changing input away and back does not resurrect the old review.
Submitted-but-unknown reviewed intent cannot be replayed.
Route change during final chain-time or simulation await stops the write.
Tiny-unit output rounding preserves the minimum output bound.
limits: Actual installed-wallet popup approval and public Fuji RPC transactions remain unverified; Fuji deployment is explicitly deferred.
Anvil fixture controls changed oracle prices and chain time; those controls are not production user functions.
Transaction Activity preserves unknown status after a receipt timeout; users must check the linked transaction before retrying. The final receipt was verified independently.
Browser console contained third-party extension warnings and one Vite hot-module createRoot warning during source edits; no new application error was observed in the completed fixed-source flows.
Contract fuzzing and local journeys are verification, not a security audit.
